title: stapelia marginata
intro: Stapelia marginata, commonly known as the "Carrion Flower" or "Starfish Flower," is a type of succulent plant in the Apocynaceae family, known for its unique and distinctive appearance. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Stapelia marginata are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
